projects.title: Argus
projects.desc: Self-hosted observability platform for microservices. Ingests logs, metrics, and traces via Kafka, processes them in real-time with Spark Streaming, and detects anomalies using Isolation Forest ML.
projects.tagline: Watches your microservices and flags what looks wrong.

projects.title: Secure Payment Microservice
projects.desc: Dual-service microservices architecture — Spring Boot REST API for transaction management and Django fraud-scoring service — containerized with Docker, orchestrated via docker-compose. OAuth2/JWT auth, MySQL for transactions, MongoDB for session/audit logs, deployed on AWS EC2.
projects.tagline: Payments API with a separate fraud-scoring service.

projects.title: ContractPilot
projects.desc: Full-stack contract lifecycle management platform with AI-powered risk analysis, e-signatures, tamper detection, and multi-party signing workflows.
projects.tagline: Contracts that get read, risk-checked and signed.

projects.title: Distributed Client-Server Performance Analysis
projects.desc: Implemented a distributed client-server architecture to analyze performance metrics under varying loads. Conducted comprehensive benchmarking of throughput, latency, and resource utilization.
projects.tagline: How a client-server system holds up as load grows.

projects.title: Meridian
projects.desc: Multi-agent LLM research assistant: a Planner splits the question, a Researcher gathers sourced evidence, a Critic sends gaps back for more research, and a Synthesizer answers with inline citations. Built on LangGraph and FastAPI; in a RAGAS evaluation the Critic raised faithfulness from 0.80 to 0.87 and cut hallucinations from 20% to 14%.
projects.tagline: Research agents that cite their sources and check each other.

projects.title: Image Manipulation Application
projects.desc: Developed a modular image-processing application using Java MVC architecture supporting CLI, GUI, and batch execution modes with advanced filters like blur, sharpen, resize, and dithering.
projects.tagline: An image editor with CLI, GUI and batch modes.

projects.title: Alzheimer's Disease Detection with ML
projects.desc: Built binary classification models using clinical datasets to predict early-stage Alzheimer's disease. Compared five supervised learning algorithms with comprehensive evaluation metrics and statistical analysis.
projects.tagline: Flagging early-stage Alzheimer’s from clinical data.

projects.title: Cardio Risk Predictor
projects.desc: Predicting heart disease risk using ensemble learning methods. Implemented multiple classification algorithms with comprehensive model evaluation and feature importance analysis for healthcare analytics.

projects.title: TrustPaws
projects.desc: Pet grooming transparency platform for Heads Up For Tails — real-time appointment tracking, service updates & incident reporting for pet parents.
projects.tagline: Live updates from your pet’s spa visit.

projects.title: Stellar Classifier
projects.desc: Predicting star types using supervised machine learning models. Built classification models to categorize stars based on astronomical features with multi-class classification and exploratory data analysis.
projects.tagline: Sorting stars into types from their measurements.

projects.title: Convolutional AutoEncoders
projects.desc: Implemented convolutional autoencoders for unsupervised feature learning and dimensionality reduction. Explored deep learning architectures for image reconstruction and denoising.
projects.tagline: Learning compact image features without labels.

projects.title: NexLedger
projects.desc: Production-grade event-sourced payment ledger with CQRS, idempotent transactions, crash-safe transfer sagas, and real-time XGBoost fraud scoring — built on Spring WebFlux, Kafka, PostgreSQL, and Redis.
projects.tagline: A payment ledger where every cent can be replayed.

projects.title: Raft KV
projects.desc: Fault-tolerant key-value store in C++20 with Raft implemented from scratch: leader election with pre-vote, log replication and a replicated state machine across a 5-node cluster. 1.94M operations verified linearizable under 16 SIGKILLs and 43 network partitions, with leader failover in a median 139 ms.
projects.tagline: Consensus from scratch in C++, survives SIGKILL.

projects.title: Tideline
projects.desc: Streaming pipeline that keeps a Delta Lake lakehouse in sync with production Postgres, row by row: Debezium reads the write-ahead log, Kafka carries the changes, and Spark merges upserts, deletes and schema changes as they happen.
projects.tagline: Production data, streamed into a lakehouse seconds behind.

projects.title: Lodestar
projects.desc: Batch analytics platform that turns raw e-commerce CSVs into a tested star-schema warehouse: dbt models and tests every step, Airflow runs it daily, and Terraform provisions it. Runs on DuckDB locally and BigQuery in production from one codebase.
projects.tagline: Messy CSVs in, a tested warehouse out.
